dct_description_sm: Multibeam echosounder (MBES) data were mosaicked from multiple survey years and vessels to create single, continuous rasters for benthic habitat mapping applications. The collation of individual datasets into one single continuous layer facilitates their use for benthic habitat mapping applications. These data were restricted to the area near Qikiqtarjuaq to focus on generating knowledge of benthic habitats to support management of marine resources near the community.
dct_title_s: Post-processed and mosaicked multibeam echosounder data near Qikiqtarjuaq, NU, Canada.
